We're currently working with over a thousand other agents, they're averaging around 1 to 3 extra deals each month on top of what they're already doing.
3.text2: I don't fully know if this would be of interest because you might be so busy that even your procrastination is behind schedule but if you do have the capacity for a few more deals and you're open to new opportunities I'd love to show you our software on a 10-15 minute call. Just let me know and I'll send over my calendar link.
